name: Veefin Solutions Ltd.
summary: Veefin Solutions Ltd. specializes in developing advanced digital lending and supply chain finance platforms. Their product suite caters to a diverse global clientele, including banks, non-banking financial institutions, FinTech companies, online marketplaces, and corporate enterprises. These innovative technological solutions are distinctively designed with a user-centric approach, heavily leveraging data and analytics, and are crafted by seasoned banking professionals specifically for the financial sector. The company was co-founded in 2018 by Raja Debnath and Gautam Vijay Udani, and its headquarters are located in Mumbai, India.
